gameplay.input: After confirming the visible A/D/W controls and Snake selection, clicked the on-page D directional control once. No additional input was sent after this click.
gameplay.response: The immediately following screenshot shows the red game block at a different board position (from upper-middle in the pre-click screenshot to lower-left in the post-click screenshot); the D control is visibly highlighted. This is a visible board response following a meaningful directional control. No score text was exposed.

entries.title: Roadster Stunt Arena
entries.ai_quote: Honestly crazy the game quality you can get in just a few prompts in the browser: - Made with Opus 5.5 - @threejs and Rapier for physics - Multiplayer with @Cloudflare

gameplay.input: Pressed Space to leave the splash screen, selected FREE RIDE, then held Shift+W for about 1.2 seconds.
gameplay.response: The car visibly accelerated from 1 MPH to 70 MPH with thrust effects. The objective counter advanced from 0/10 to 1/10 and recorded 0–60 MPH in 0.98 seconds.
